add.content: Composition adjustment reduced additive-manufacturing microcracks in Hastelloy X.
add.evidence_span: By increasing the solid solution strengthening elements in the Ni-base superalloy Hastelloy X within the existing commercial alloy composition range, a reduction in microcracking in AM was observed

add.content: Co-Al-W precipitation strengthening motivated the CoNi alloy design space.
add.evidence_span: Recent interest in Co-base superalloys commenced with the study of Sato et al. that revealed the possibility of precipitation strengthening in the Co–Al–W ternary system

add.content: Ti, Ta, Nb, and Ni additions improve creep strength in single-crystal variants.
add.evidence_span: Calculations indicated that Ti, Ta, Nb, and Ni were favorable alloying additions. Creep experiments on several SX variants of these materials confirmed that alloys with these elements possessed creep strengths

add.content: The designed alloy has a 125 degrees C solidus-solvus processing window.
add.evidence_span: γ ′ -solvus, solidus, and liquidus values for this alloy have been measured by differential thermal analysis as 1204, 1329, and 1381 °C, respectively

add.content: EBM produces more strongly columnar build-aligned grains than low-preheat SLM.
add.evidence_span: In the higher preheat EBM process, there is a greater tendency for grains to be columnar and to assume the preferred solidification growth direction of 〈001〉 aligned with the build direction.

add.content: The high-gamma-prime CoNi alloy remains ductile and crack resistant unlike comparable printed Ni superalloys.
add.evidence_span: The SB-CoNi-10 alloy demonstrates significantly improved ductility and resistance to cracking compared to similar Ni-base superalloys produced by PBF

add.content: Repeated EBM thermal excursions can anneal solute segregation.
add.evidence_span: the layer-by-layer thermal excursions in the EBM process might be expected to influence the observed solute segregation

add.content: Hot isostatic pressing removes porosity and recrystallizes the microstructure.
add.evidence_span: HIP applied above the γ ′ -solvus temperature ( T HIP = 1245 °C) resulted in a microstructure that was free from porosity and also resulted in recrystallization of the microstructure into a coarse-grained equiaxed microstructure
